<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Shravani Jadhav</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=Newsreader:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Caveat:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --cream: #f5f0e8;
      --paper: #faf7f2;
      --ink: #1a1814;
      --ink-light: #4a4540;
      --ink-faint: #9a9590;
      --rust: #c4622d;
      --rust-light: #e8956a;
      --sage: #5a7a5c;
      --border: #ddd8cc;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      background: var(--paper);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif;
      font-weight: 300;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .top-strip {
      background: var(--ink);
      color: var(--cream);
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      font-size: 14px;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 7px 0;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      background: var(--paper);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 1rem 3rem;
    }

    .nav-logo {
      font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      color: var(--ink);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-logo span {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      color: var(--rust);
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-left: 6px;
    }

    .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; }
    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--ink-light);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-family: 'Newsreader', serif;
      font-style: italic;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--rust); }

    #hero {
      max-width: 860px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 5rem 2rem 3rem;
    }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--rust);
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }

    h1 {
      font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      font-weight: 400;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--rust); }

    .hero-intro {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--ink-light);
      max-width: 580px;
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .hero-intro strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }

    .hero-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }

    .chip {
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--ink-light);
      background: var(--cream);
      font-family: 'Newsreader', serif;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .chip.accent { border-color: var(--rust-light); color: var(--rust); background: #fdf0e8; }

    .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .btn-main {
      background: var(--ink);
      color: var(--paper);
      padding: 0.75rem 1.8rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-family: 'Newsreader', serif;
      font-style: italic;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-main:hover { background: var(--rust); }

    .btn-soft {
      color: var(--ink-light);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-style: italic;
      font-family: 'Newsreader', serif;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 1px;
      transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-soft:hover { color: var(--rust); border-color: var(--rust-light); }

    .divider { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 2rem; }
    .divider hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .section { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 4rem 2rem; }

    .section-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    h2 {
      font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .section-num { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 1rem; }

    .about-body {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .profile-img {
      width: 180px;
      height: 180px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
      border: 5px solid #d4af37;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }

    .about-text p { color: var(--ink-light); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; font-size: 1rem; }
    .about-text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .about-text strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }

    .about-aside {
      background: var(--cream);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .aside-title { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .aside-list { list-style: none; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--ink-light); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .aside-list li::before { content: '→ '; color: var(--rust); font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; }

    #skills { background: var(--cream); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .skills-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 2rem; }

    .skill-group-title {
      font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--ink);
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .skill-list { list-style: none; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--ink-light); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .skill-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .skill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rust-light); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .skill-dot.green { background: var(--sage); }
    .skill-dot.faint { background: var(--border); }
    .skill-note { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-top: 0.4rem; }

    .projects-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

    .project-item {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2rem 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .project-item:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .project-num-label { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .project-name { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-top: 0.2rem; line-height: 1.25; }
    .project-tech-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.8rem; }
    .tech-pill { font-size: 0.73rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: 'Newsreader', serif; font-style: italic; }
    .project-desc { color: var(--ink-light); font-size: 0.97rem; line-height: 1.75; }
    .project-takeaway { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--sage); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-top: 0.8rem; }

    #education { background: var(--cream); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .edu-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2rem; }
    .edu-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: start; }
    .edu-year { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 1rem; padding-top: 0.15rem; }
    .edu-degree { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 400; }
    .edu-school { color: var(--ink-light); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.2rem; }
    .edu-note { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; }

    .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; align-items: start; }
    .contact-text p { color: var(--ink-light); font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .contact-items { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2rem; }
    .contact-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; }
    .contact-label { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 0.88rem; }
    .contact-val { font-family: 'Newsreader', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; width: fit-content; }
    .contact-val:hover { color: var(--rust); border-bottom-color: var(--rust-light); }

    footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2rem 3rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .footer-left { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink-faint); }
    .footer-right { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: var(--rust); font-size: 0.9rem; }

    .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease; }
    .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      nav { padding: 1rem 1.2rem; }
      .nav-links { gap: 1rem; }
      .about-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .skills-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .project-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .edu-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
      footer { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; text-align: center; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="top-strip">open to internships &amp; collaborations · Pune, Maharashtra</div>

  <nav>
    <a href="#hero" class="nav-logo">Shravani Jadhav <span>✦</span></a>
    <ul class="nav-links">
      <li><a href="#about">about</a></li>
      <li><a href="#skills">skills</a></li>
      <li><a href="#projects">projects</a></li>
      <li><a href="#education">education</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact">contact</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>

  <section id="hero">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow">hello, I'm —</div>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <img class="profile-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Shravani Jadhav" />
      <h1>Shravani<br/><em>Jadhav.</em></h1>
    </div>
    <p class="hero-intro">
      A passionate <strong>Computer Science</strong> student who loves building things and solving problems with code. Always curious, always learning — and genuinely excited about what technology can do.
    </p>
    <div class="hero-tags">
      <span class="chip accent">Computer Science</span>
      <span class="chip">Pune, Maharashtra</span>
      <span class="chip">Web Developer</span>
      <span class="chip">always building</span>
      <span class="chip">open to opportunities</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-ctas">
      <a href="#projects" class="btn-main">see my projects</a>
      <a href="#contact" class="btn-soft">or just say hi →</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="divider"><hr/></div>

  <section id="about" class="section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-num">01.</span>
      <h2>A bit about me</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="about-body reveal">
      <div class="about-text">
        <p>I'm Shravani — a Computer Science student from Pune with a genuine love for building things that matter. I was drawn to tech because of how it can transform ideas into real, working products that people actually use.</p>
        <p>Right now I'm sharpening my skills in web development and programming — writing cleaner code, understanding design patterns, and learning how to make software that's both functional and beautiful. I spend time on GitHub pushing projects and learning from others' work.</p>
        <p>Outside of coursework, I'm the kind of person who gets lost in building side projects at odd hours. I'm looking for internships, collaborations, or just interesting people to learn from and build with.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="about-aside">
        <div class="aside-title">a few quick things —</div>
        <ul class="aside-list">
          <li>CS student, Pune</li>
          <li>Passionate about web dev</li>
          <li>Active on GitHub</li>
          <li>Problem-solver at heart</li>
          <li>Loves clean, thoughtful design</li>
          <li>Open to internships &amp; projects</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="skills">
    <div class="section" style="padding-top:3.5rem;padding-bottom:3.5rem;">
      <div class="section-head">
        <span class="section-num">02.</span>
        <h2>What I know <em style="font-style:italic;color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:1.4rem;">(so far)</em></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="skills-cols reveal">
        <div class="skill-group">
          <div class="skill-group-title">Languages &amp; Tools</div>
          <ul class="skill-list">
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>Python</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>JavaScript</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>HTML &amp; CSS</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>Java</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>Git &amp; GitHub</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>VS Code</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="skill-group">
          <div class="skill-group-title">Web &amp; Frameworks</div>
          <ul class="skill-list">
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>React (basics)</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>Node.js</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot"></span>REST APIs</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot green"></span>Responsive Design</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>MySQL / SQL</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>MongoDB</li>
          </ul>
          <div class="skill-note">getting better every week</div>
        </div>
        <div class="skill-group">
          <div class="skill-group-title">CS Fundamentals</div>
          <ul class="skill-list">
            <li><span class="skill-dot green"></span>Data Structures</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot green"></span>Algorithms</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>OOP Concepts</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>DBMS</li>
            <li><span class="skill-dot faint"></span>Operating Systems</li>
          </ul>
          <div class="skill-note">still learning, not pretending otherwise</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="projects" class="section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-num">03.</span>
      <h2>Things I've worked on</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="projects-list reveal">

      <div class="project-item">
        <div class="project-meta">
          <div class="project-num-label">project 01</div>
          <div class="project-name">Personal Portfolio Website</div>
          <div class="project-tech-row">
            <span class="tech-pill">HTML</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">CSS</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">JavaScript</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="project-content">
          <p class="project-desc">Designed and built my own portfolio website from scratch to showcase my skills and projects. Focused on clean design, smooth animations, and making it fully responsive across all devices.</p>
          <div class="project-takeaway">✏️ learned: CSS animations, responsive layouts, design thinking</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="project-item">
        <div class="project-meta">
          <div class="project-num-label">project 02</div>
          <div class="project-name">Task Management App</div>
          <div class="project-tech-row">
            <span class="tech-pill">React</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">JavaScript</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">CSS</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="project-content">
          <p class="project-desc">Built a functional to-do and task management app with features like task categories, due dates, and local storage persistence. A project that actually became useful in my daily life.</p>
          <div class="project-takeaway">✏️ learned: React state management, localStorage, component design</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="project-item">
        <div class="project-meta">
          <div class="project-num-label">project 03</div>
          <div class="project-name">Student Database System</div>
          <div class="project-tech-row">
            <span class="tech-pill">Python</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">MySQL</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">SQL</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="project-content">
          <p class="project-desc">Created a CRUD-based student record management system with Python and MySQL. Implemented search, filter, and report generation features. Got hands-on with database design for the first time.</p>
          <div class="project-takeaway">✏️ learned: SQL queries, database design, Python-MySQL integration</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="project-item">
        <div class="project-meta">
          <div class="project-num-label">project 04</div>
          <div class="project-name">Weather Dashboard</div>
          <div class="project-tech-row">
            <span class="tech-pill">JavaScript</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">REST API</span>
            <span class="tech-pill">HTML/CSS</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="project-content">
          <p class="project-desc">Built a real-time weather dashboard using the OpenWeatherMap API. Shows current conditions, 5-day forecasts, and location-based data. My first proper experience working with external APIs.</p>
          <div class="project-takeaway">✏️ learned: API integration, async/await, JSON data handling</div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="education">
    <div class="section" style="padding-top:3.5rem;padding-bottom:3.5rem;">
      <div class="section-head">
        <span class="section-num">04.</span>
        <h2>Education</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="edu-list reveal">
        <div class="edu-item">
          <div class="edu-year">present</div>
          <div class="edu-content">
            <div class="edu-degree">B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science</div>
            <div class="edu-school">Studying: Data Structures, Web Development, DBMS, OOP, Operating Systems</div>
            <div class="edu-note">enjoying every bit of it, honestly</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="edu-item">
          <div class="edu-year">2023</div>
          <div class="edu-content">
            <div class="edu-degree">HSC — Science Stream</div>
            <div class="edu-school">Maharashtra State Board · Physics, Chemistry, Maths &amp; Computer Science</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="edu-item">
          <div class="edu-year">ongoing</div>
          <div class="edu-content">
            <div class="edu-degree">Online Courses &amp; Self Learning</div>
            <div class="edu-school">Web Development — Udemy &nbsp;·&nbsp; JavaScript — freeCodeCamp &nbsp;·&nbsp; Python — NPTEL</div>
            <div class="edu-note">because curiosity doesn't wait for a syllabus</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="contact" class="section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-num">05.</span>
      <h2>Get in touch</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="contact-grid reveal">
      <div class="contact-text">
        <p>I'm actively looking for internship opportunities, open-source collaborations, hackathon teammates, or just interesting conversations about tech, development, or design.</p>
        <p>If you're a fellow student, a mentor, or someone hiring — I'd genuinely love to hear from you. I reply to all emails (give me a day or two).</p>
        <p style="font-family:'Caveat',cursive;color:var(--rust);font-size:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem;">— Shravani</p>
      </div>
      <div class="contact-items">
        <div class="contact-row">
          <span class="contact-label">email</span>
          <a href="mailto:shravanijadhav4321@gmail.com" class="contact-val">shravanijadhav4321@gmail.com</a>
        </div>
        <div class="contact-row">
          <span class="contact-label">phone</span>
          <a href="tel:+918793681317" class="contact-val">+91 87936 81317</a>
        </div>
        <div class="contact-row">
          <span class="contact-label">github</span>
          <a href="https://github.com/shravanijadhav1234" target="_blank" class="contact-val">github.com/shravanijadhav1234</a>
        </div>
        <div class="contact-row">
          <span class="contact-label">linkedin</span>
          <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shravani-jadhav-a8a58b39b" target="_blank" class="contact-val">linkedin.com/in/shravani-jadhav</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <div class="footer-left">Shravani Jadhav · 2026</div>
    <div class="footer-right">built with passion, not just code ✌️</div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    const els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in'); });
    }, { threshold: 0.08 });
    els.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

</body>
</html>
